steps.name: Guard
steps.text: Is it just me, or is the sky getting darker?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...If only it was just you.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We never had much time anyway.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: The shape of the Catastrophe cloud is more clearly defined than the black haze it was before.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Tsk. I don't like the feeling I get from watching it form over our heads. What a bad omen.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: To make things worse, Reunion goons might be lurking in every nook and cranny.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Actually, that's probably too conservative.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: What you should've said is that they're probably partying on the streets.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Almost every street is filled with destruction, violence and looting. Vehicles and buildings are being set on fire...

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: But these thugs decide that it's the perfect weather for a picnic!

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: If they're going out on a picnic now, it's the Catastrophe that will feast upon their bones.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: This proves that most Reunion members are just fools who've been whipped into a frenzy.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Pfft.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Look, they're not really having a picnic...

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: I, I just wanted something to moan about. You didn't have to take me so seriously...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Oh, you weren't being serious？Wait, were you trying to crack a joke?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Sorry, I'm not good with this stuff...

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Umm... It's fine...

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: It's just that... trying not to laugh is hard...

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: Um, sorry... for trying to make a joke at such a serious time...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's okay.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island wasn't founded for the sake of having everyone keep a serious face.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We've always wanted everyone to be able to smile.

steps.name: Medic
steps.text: A-Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't worry about it!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: In any case, let's help out with the scouting.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I'll quietly dispatch the enemy at our four o'clock.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Hopefully their diseased organs won't explode or be rigged to serve as some kind of alarm.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: We'll wrap around and take care of the large group on the other side of the fortification.

steps.name: Ace
steps.text: With this much chaos around us, nobody will notice a little more noise.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: All right, let's move out!
